implementation: Native HEPKit cut-diagram projections shared by Rust, CLI and descriptive Python methods

validation.release_command: cargo test --locked --release --features python_stubgen --test python_cut_interfaces --test native_cut_interfaces --test hepkit_cuts --test mixed_cut_flow --test massless_phase_space --test combinations --test cli

initial_gate.status: Informational pre-cancellation-tightening gate. Its build fingerprint was generated during the dependency build before the final equivalent helper-reference cleanup. Final evidence is the frozen 41-test gate and its matching source/Clippy digest.

python_native_inputs: existing HEPKit FeynmanDiagram with shared Model owner
explicit cut index and future channel
native loop-order prescriptions and optional edge powers
interfaces.other_error_policy: Existing reduction/resource/numerical errors remain typed through the shared exception mapper. Ordinary ReductionTables do not authorize cut reductions; a backend must explicitly own reduce_cut.
interfaces.gil_and_control: Native construction and evaluation detach the GIL. The threaded Python regression polls native progress and cancels an active evaluation; a deterministic Rust backend-cancellation regression prevents returning prepared state after cancellation.
interfaces.stub_validation: Generated inventory stubs include both methods, native FeynmanDiagram/Kinematics types, exact channel/prescription arguments and edge powers.
interfaces.cli: graph steering accepts an optional cut selection; finite samples return operation cut_graph_samples and verified_digits=null; omitting epsilon_samples gives independently refined cut_graph Laurent output. Ordinary graph JSON is unchanged.

scientific_coverage: 20-digit weighted two-body Laurent coefficients with native D=4-2 epsilon contraction and an extra numerator pole; analytic volume and finite coefficient compared independently.
30 requested and independently fitted decimal digits through the native Python phase-space interface; finite sample compared to the independent gamma expression at 50 digits.

Exact single-pass point substitution, raised-cut derivative signs, nonzero guards even for zero numerator rows, invalid physical measures and epsilon samples, direct and native-encoded exact complex weights.

Connected native two-loop graph with massive phi cut shells and a massless chi virtual bubble, native requested loop-edge basis and native cut partitions. Exact M=1 overrides model default 123. Finite epsilon 1/13 matches the independent phase-volume times bubble gamma product at 20 digits.
Shared mixed cut projections at epsilon 1/13 and 1/17 retain epsilon pole weights and cancellation with a raised-cut target.
Two- and three-loop all-cut massless projection dispatch retains determinant Jacobians, permutations and inherited/extra epsilon poles.
Existing ordinary projection and CLI transport regressions pass unchanged.
accuracy_scope: Finite-epsilon outputs carry working precision only, without a guaranteed accuracy field. Laurent solve uses the existing independent-grid/increased-precision fitter and reports achieved comparison evidence; no global interval certificate is claimed.

reuse_audit.root_review: No substantive blocker; shared ordinary helper preserves prior behavior and dispatch never suppresses domain errors.
reuse_audit.independent_peer_review: Endpoint/cache agent found no substantive admission issue and recommended per-row/final cancellation checks; implemented and validated.

owners.boundaries_and_transport: existing PreparedCutFlow and phase-space terminal owners

reuse_audit.dependency_uniqueness: dependency-ownership.json records exactly one resolved owner each for Symbolica, Numerica, RustRed, HEPKit model/graph/kinematics/Python/tensor, Linnet, Spenso and Idenso. Locked official Symbolica community and RustRed sources are unchanged.

remaining_scope: Complete positive-energy final states with uniform +i0 virtual directions remain the current automatic mixed-cut domain.
Massive two-body and massless N-body terminals; general massive N-body, singular thresholds, interior real-phase-space poles and cut-preserving partial fractions remain unsupported.
No persistent numerical cut cache or cache schema change. No reference numerical values enter evaluation.
No new whole-algorithm performance comparison; target runtimes above are regression-suite timings.
deployment_scope: Bindings are validated in the embedded shared native Python runtime of this crate. No publication host wheel, community source, numerical bank or runtime was edited or rebuilt by this milestone.
